title: Maximum Total Priority of Non-Overlapping Meetings with at Most k Meetings
statement: You are given n meetings. The i-th meeting starts at start[i] and ends at end[i] (both inclusive) and has a priority priority[i]. You may attend at most k meetings such that no two attended meetings overlap (i.e., for any two attended meetings i and j, either end[i] < start[j] or end[j] < start[i]). Return the maximum possible sum of priorities of the attended meetings.
summary: Return the maximum total priority of at most k non-overlapping meetings.

examples.explanation: Choose meetings [1,2] (priority 2) and [5,7] (priority 4). They do not overlap and total priority is 6.
With only one meeting allowed, pick the meeting with highest priority 30.
